newsitem.title: HONG KONG: BankAmerica says opens Beijing office.
newsitem.headline: BankAmerica says opens Beijing office.

text.p: Bank of America Corp said on Monday it had received official approval from the People's Bank of China to upgrade its representative office in Beijing to full branch status with effect immediately.
Bank of America has branches in Shanghai and Guangzhou and a representative office in Dalian, it said in a statement released in Hong Kong.
The new branch would provide the full range of commercial and investment banking services, the bank said.
The Beijing branch is an important link in its global network which would allow the bank to expand its range of services to both mainland and international clients, it said.
